_readme: Shared contract for find_passage. bmlib's Python (tests/test_passage_match_contract.py) and Rust (rust/bmlib/tests/passage_match_contract.rs) assert against this file. Expected values are hand-written, never generated by the code under test. Offsets are Unicode code-point indices. similarity is asserted only where present; min_similarity_at_least is a lower bound for fuzzy cases.
